title: Verify the new PR5580 rank-four paid native map on all 512 inputs
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

PR5580 introduces a newly used paid native map, ordered frames `[] → [11,21,33,455]` (3→737), at event 12658 on public owner 451. This package independently checks the actual lowered rank-four recipe against its defining nine-axis circuit on all 512 basis inputs, including absolute phase. Matrix SHA256: `4880642a0492ed39e066828674c80eaf3f62cccbd68a3b45b17bccbe03f1245e`.

The audit covers 262144 complex entries, unit norm/support 16 per column, 18 signed Pauli images and independent B-block rank 4. Eight controls reject phase, sign, boundary, orientation, charged-rank, occurrence and source-corruption faults. The unchanged credited PR5548 dense interpreter is reused; mode equality is reproducibility, not independent engine implementation or human/formal acceptance.

## Task and overlap

Audited construction head: `6efa248cf456d6101d757e9d09ba29711d18a13a`. Strict ordered-boundary lookup found no matching receipt in the named PR5572, old 182-map and PR5585 sets. This is not a universal operator-inequivalence claim. The broader predecessor receipts and PR5573 remain credited, with no automatic whole 5580 transfer.

The current source curator observes a newer rewritten PR5565 conditional claim and other ongoing coupled-frame/global-controller/query-decoder work. This frozen one-map check is distinct and supplies no automatic coverage of 5565 or those constructions. PR5590's fixed-contact price floor is a separate reported result; its structural rank checks do not replace this 512-column absolute-phase audit. No price/profile, shared code, selected record or new κ is changed. Selected κ remains .003027288235 at the accepted main checkpoint.

## Validation

The original frozen normal/-O pair passed in 2.4163 s, sampled peak 53,616,640 bytes, reproducing complete result SHA256 `896021cbb14577bc242d8c884210b56e9ded0133acf02ab22295c3324e657ad9`. Portable metadata and 12 integrity controls pass before science. The registered normal/-O replay passed in 3.3211 s, sampled peak 108,310,528 bytes; a relocated read-only Git-free optimized export with spaces and empty PATH passed in 1.4083 s, sampled peak 59,318,272 bytes. All 57 exported files remain unchanged.

Exact fork commit `1ec84cdaf27b6dc396dd83cc50feb863ddb88cf5`, tree `4f5f571c4f7ad45aa1a54208e1c5ef032de14463`, 56 added files, passes committed-byte/source-history checks. Fetch reported a missing unrelated base blob; the target commit/package objects were present and the exact 56-file check passed without another fetch or scientific retry. The package uses available canonical ancestor 32890 with separately refreshed current guidance; it does not represent that ancestor as current main. Hosted CI is pending upstream creation.

Reproduce: `python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/pr5580-native-pair-audit`.

Ali Romman 5580; GamingPuzzled 5569, DreamingOfClouds 5561, thu-nmrc 5551; Matarener 5572/5569 review; Scratch-net 5585; Chris R/Clear1nsight 5548 dense arithmetic, 5550 caller and 5573 subset; and the retained native, Clifford, controller, productive recursion, compiler and analytic lineage. New audit/packaging for Chris R/Clear1nsight with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

This establishes one finite native identity only. Full source/occurrence transfer, local 743-row ABI, complete caller, all-width physical implementation and framework assumptions, owned erasure, ordinary precision/tape/storage and applicable compiler/outer funding remain separate. A useful next task is an exact source-bound occurrence/receipt applicability join; do not rerun broad historical native suites by default or infer any funded κ from this component check. Respect the current coupled-frame/global-controller/query-decoder and helper-basis scopes before starting broader work.
